query:
FROM logs-postgresql.log-*
| WHERE host.name == "db-1" AND @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T00:00:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T00:00:00Z"
| EVAL msg_prefix = SUBSTRING(message, 0, 50)
| STATS count = COUNT(*) BY msg_prefix
| SORT count DESC
| LIMIT 30
